title: vault_io.py: partition-aware IO layer (read_table / write_partition / row_count / list_ym + ym helpers)
objective: Implement etl4/vault/vault_io.py per vault_io_spec.md (T-04). Single public reader/writer surface over silver/vault and gold/marts under the ym=YYYY-MM partition contract. Encapsulates partition-aware reads with monolithic fallback, atomic per-ym writes, and the three ym derivation helpers (filename / date / epoch) so every writer path agrees bit-for-bit.
unblocks: T-17 (postgres_sink.py per-ym staged INSERT ON CONFLICT reader)

spec_gaps_resolved: Spec says 'read individual files and concat' (CLAUDE.md section 7) -- implemented via per-file pq.read_table + pd.concat(ignore_index=True), never pd.read_parquet(tree_root).
Spec allows Spark writer filenames (part-NNNNN-*.parquet) -- reader globs '<ym_dir>/*.parquet', smoke CASE 8 verifies.

Spec reserves SYN-<hex> sentinel for synthetic matrix cells on write_partition only -- read_table/row_count/list_ym treat SYN partitions uniformly with YYYY-MM partitions (lexically); the CHECK regex on pipeline_watermarks.last_ym is the only place that excludes SYN. Smoke CASE 6 writes SYN-002A and CASE 9 verifies extract_ym_from_path returns it.
